title: M5f: Agent workbench guardrails
description:
Make the M5c workbench safe and convenient for coding agents at the
`full` trust level: the container keeps the host filesystem out of an
agent's reach, credentials arrive through forwarded agents rather than
key files, and Claude Code runs with permission prompts bypassed behind
a deny-list hook. Design: "Agents in a Full Workbench" in
docs/project/milestones/M5c-composable-container-workspaces.md.
Non-goals: protecting accounts the workbench's credentials can reach
(that is M5d `sealed`); container or kernel escapes.
acceptance: What a `full` workbench protects, and what it does not, is recorded in docs/design/container-standards.md and docs/design/architecture.md
Rendered definitions meet the filesystem guardrails and `--check` enforces them: no container-runtime socket, no host home or /mnt/c mount, no --privileged, no host network
SSH works inside a workbench through a forwarded agent, including the 1Password SSH agent on the host, with no private key files mounted, from VS Code and from CLI terminal mode
Claude Code starts with permission prompts bypassed in a workbench where it is selected, and a deny-list hook blocks the listed catastrophic commands
verify: uv run pytest -q && uv run pre-commit run --all-files

title: M5e: Zero to Hero developer workstation
description:
Take a fresh Ubuntu or macOS install to a full DevOps development
workstation with the fewest commands: Dev Fortress and shell-config in
development mode, the host toolchain, and a workbench for agentic
development, in under an hour. The first step is the baseline run
(tracked under M6b because it doubles as the docs read-through).
Non-goals: desktop apps beyond prerequisites; Windows-native hosts;
integrating the dotfiles repo beyond restoring
~/.config/dev-container-fortress/.
acceptance: The installer's `host` mode converges a fresh macOS install (Apple silicon first) as it does Ubuntu
A developer mode clones shell-config beside the Dev Fortress checkout and runs the host shell from that clone, and the host bootstrap leaves a developer's checkout alone
The developer path in DEVELOPMENT.md shrinks to the installer, one login, and `ft workbench init` plus `clone`
Timed cold runs from a fresh bare-metal Ubuntu install and a fresh macOS install finish in under an hour, with the time recorded
verify: uv run pytest -q && uv run pre-commit run --all-files
